digest.component_or_area: build and test workflow, linting infrastructure
propositions: scripts/ directory (41 files) is excluded from lint and typecheck gates via Makefile sources variable, allowing 78 ruff violations and 7 formatter nonconformance to accumulate uncaught
28 substantive ruff check violations (RUF100 x12, E501 x11, RUF005 x2, RUF059 x2, B905 x1, RUF036 x1) across scripts/ must be resolved before adding scripts to lint scope

50 T201 (print statement) violations must be consolidated from nine per-file-ignores entries to a single 'scripts/**' entry in pyproject.toml, requiring simultaneous deletion of 28 inline noqa directives to avoid new RUF100 violations
Seven CI-invoked gate scripts within .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml must produce identical behavior before and after linting fixes
Adding scripts/ to Makefile sources enrolls all 41 files in both ruff check and ruff format, requiring formatter conformance (7 files would be reformatted) before enabling the gate
